name: web-curved-3d-image-carousel-ring-on-dotted-white
title: Ring of rounded photo cards curving around an invisible cylinder, on a dotted white ground
whatItIs: A horizontal ring of rounded-square nature photos (forest fog, a cormorant on water, blue rapids, a waterfall) that curve away in 3D perspective, the centre cards sharp and the outer ones narrowing, on a faint dotted background.
whatItMeans: Elegant and tactile; the curve turns a plain gallery into an object you can spin.
techniques: Arrange cards on a circular path in 3D.
Scale and skew outer cards to imply depth.

vocabulary.definition: Items placed around a cylinder that rotate.
Items narrowing as they turn away.
A photo with softly rounded corners.
A faint dot grid as background.
